_comment: FMS_UI on the Postgres deployment (kube-config-opm/ingress-preprod.yml: pg-fms-ui.app.fintech.com). STARTING POINT for Phase 3: the API hosts live in the ADO variable group fms-ui-postgres-preprod (REACT_APP_*_HOSTNAME), not in the repo. Run one headed discovery with 1 user and 1 company; it prints every API host the app called that is missing below. Add gateway hosts to gatewayBaseUrls; add hosts the app calls directly to gatewayBaseUrls AND hostServices (URL prefix -> service name in config/services.json). The login finds the token-exchange and companies hosts from the app's own calls (authApiBaseUrl / usersApiBaseUrl only override that). Users: LT_FMS_USER_<n>_EMAIL / _PASSWORD in .env (Auth0 users, MFA off; e.g. user1 a retailer, user2 a distributor). auth0Domain: the tenant the app redirects to (seen in a login probe).
name: pg-fms
